items.title: US reportedly approves potential $621.9 million F-16 support package for Ukraine
items.summary: The US State Department reportedly approved a potential package to sustain Ukraine's F-16 fleet, financed by Belgium, Denmark, the Netherlands and Norway through JUMPSTART rather than US funds. The approval does not establish that deliveries have occurred.

items.title: Kushner anticipates major Russia–Ukraine prisoner exchange before year-end
items.summary: US presidential envoy Jared Kushner said a large prisoner exchange between Russia and Ukraine is expected before the end of the year. No numbers or agreed date were provided in the available report.

items.title: Kushner outlines US approach to Ukraine peace negotiations
items.summary: Jared Kushner said Washington would support a settlement that ends hostilities and that the coming weeks would indicate whether its negotiating approach works. He said the US understands Moscow's reluctance to accept a ceasefire without a peace agreement and argued that US security guarantees must serve American interests.

items.title: Russian embassy in Moldova warns of alleged provocation
items.summary: Russia's embassy in Moldova said it had received information about a planned anti-Russian provocation and urged Chisinau to avoid escalation. The embassy's allegation was not independently verified, and the available reports provided no specific details or Moldovan response.
